packageRules.description: Build container must match the Zephyr version of the pinned ZMK (3.5 for v0.3-branch). Digest refreshes only; tag moves to 4.x are a deliberate migration.
Branch-pinned west projects are bumped by commit, so Renovate finds no release notes. Link the commit comparison in the PR body instead.
Digest refreshes of the floating 3.5-branch tag are rebuilds of zmk-docker's 3.5-branch (base image and package updates), so there are no release notes. Link that branch's history instead.

customManagers.description: ZMK pin in config/west.yml. Captures only the commit SHA; the branch name is a literal so Renovate tracks the branch head.
